name: Payment Error Manager
author: yetsa

sections.description:
Never miss a sale again. Customize what happens when a customer encounters an error during payment.

Features

Provide alternative payment options via email to a customer when they encounter an error during payment.

  • Auto-complete orders regardless of payment errors at checkout
  • Customize the error message sent to customers via email
  • Customize the error message sent to the admin via email

Payment Gateway Support

Version 1 of this plugin currently supports only the Paystack WooCommerce Payment Gateway.
Support for additional payment gateways may be added in future releases.

How do I provide an alternative when customers encounter an error during payment?

Go to Payment Error Manager settings page, customize the email sent to customers and include an alternative payment method to the email.

How do I auto complete orders regardless of payment error?

Go to Payment Error Manager settings page under menu, then mark the checkbox beside “Auto-complete Order on Error”.
